Name: LG Electronics

At the same time, we continue to expand into new growth areas including AI Home, smart factories, robotics and platform-based services such as webOS, building on our strengths in both consumer technology and B2B solutions.

Our management philosophy, Jeong-do Management, reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency and doing business the right way. Built on the principles of customer value creation and people-oriented management, our culture encourages collaboration, creativity and growth.

Join us as we continue to shape what comes next, because at LG, Life’s Good.

Name: Halo 4 Safety FZE
Description:
H4LO is a safety awareness device that alerts the user when there is a risk of unintentional contact or overhead entrapment while operating a MEWP (mobile elevated work platform).

 H4LO  is worn by the user rather than a device fitted to the MEWP.
H4LO attaches to a specific safety helmet and doesn’t rely on the MEWP having an additional safety device fitted.

The use of MEWP’s can save time, make work at height more efficient, effective and safer than using traditional methods of access. Unfortunately, accidents involving MEWP’s occur, including tragically some fatalities, some have involved users being crushed while accessing their work area or working at height near obstructions. These incidents could have been avoided by thorough planning, selection of the appropriate equipment, professional training and by using the innovative  H4LO awareness divice.

There are over 1.5million MEWPS currently in global rental fleets and more than 90% of these are not fitted with any anti entrapment or safety devices to alert the user of potential overhead obstructions.
The H4LO attachment offers a cost effective solution to every user of MEWPS worldwide.

In 2016 there were 66 reported fatalities involving MEWP’s worldwide, the main causes were falls from height , entrapment, electrocution and overturn of machinery. 
Entrapment accounted for 18% of the reported fatalities in 2016, worryingly this is trending upwards from 16% in 2015. These figures together with the increasing number of injuries and near misses specific to unintentional contact, crushing or entrapment highlights the need to find a solution to this issue.
 H4LO offers a solution to help reduce this risk.

Name: Canford Audio Limited
Description:
Canford Audio - The Essential Source since 1976
 
Few names are as synonymous with the industry as Canford. In 1976, Iain Elliott (the driving force behind Canford) had the simple idea of creating a one-stop shop for everything needed for broadcast infrastructure and, thus, the 'Essential Source' was born.
 
As the company has grown over the decades, we have explored new avenues and ventures (including our custom metalwork manufacturing plant in Portland, Dorset) as well as merging Panamic, Tecpro, EMO and NEAL into the Canford Group. Our huge, and ever-expanding, product portfolio boasts around 20,000 carefully selected lines from more than 225 brands, all of which cater for broadcast, live events, pro AV, and many other industry sectors.

The reason behind this? All of our customers receive the same exceptional level of customer service that Canford has become renowned for. To better assist our overseas customers, we also have regional offices in Strasbourg (France), and Dubai (UAE).
 
In 2019, Canford was transferred to an Employee Ownership Trust to be run for the long-term benefit of all present and future employees. The Canford Group continues to operate under the same guiding principles that we always have, which also guarantees a significant workforce based in the North East of England.
 
In late 2021, Iain Elliott sadly passed away. And so it is up to us, the Canford employees, to build on his vision and to continue his legacy. Simple ideas can change everything.

Description:
Storing thousands of our most precious memories, notes and connections, the mobile phone has become somewhat part of our DNA and if you’ve ever had to replace your phone’s screen you already know the value in having fast, affordable protection at your fingertips. Now more than ever, it’s important that you are able to enjoy unrestricted use of your device with the knowledge that it is fully protected wherever you go. Even with a wide range of screen protectors available, most service providers only stock products that fit the latest models, which means that many customers don’t have access to premium-quality options. This is where Quix comes in! Holding an invaluable database of over 15 000 devices that we have been building for over a decade, we’re in the business of protecting any phone, anywhere, any time.

With innovation at the core of everything we do, Quix started out in the Thermo Plastic Urethane industry (TPU) in 2005 where we focused mainly on surface protection. With mobile phones becoming popular worldwide in 2007, we soon realized that we could harness TPU’s non-hazardous, conformable and impact resistant potential to provide efficient solutions for mobile-phone users all over the globe. With a quick strategic pivot, we began applying the ultra-durable material to mobile screens for comprehensive protection and we’ve been gifting our customers’ the confidence to use their phones to their fullest potential ever since.

After spending over a decade refining our product, Quix screen protectors are guaranteed to fit any phone model from the early 2000s to 2020 and our offering keeps growing as new models are released. Our protectors provide flawless edge to edge covering for your screen with the added bonus of being able to cover the sides if you choose. Our lifetime warranty means that you have nothing to lose and everything to gain when you invest in Quix protection.

Description:
Welcome to Resonant Link technology, an exciting, innovative and advanced power conversion technology with multiple applications which emanates from the US Star Wars programme.  The technology is fully patented and protected.  
We are currently looking for investors and/or technology partners for exclusive worldwide applications including active transformers (AC and DC), wind turbines, VFDs, marine propulsion, VAR controllers et al.   
Main benefits of Resonant Link technology are :
Patented soft switching technology ‐ ‘Soft switching’ (i.e. no switching losses) of the devices enables full power throughput up to 20 kHz. Resonant Link technology can convert significantly more power (e.g.  5.5MW cu.m. at MV) than conventional power conversion systems.
Very high‐power density (~5.5MW/cu.m.) ‐ Resonant Link converters have ~60‐80% less footprint than conventional systems of the same MW rating. 
Sinusoidal voltages and currents ‐ Input and output THDi (AC) are <1% THDi and du/dt 13.7V at 4.16kV. 
High conversion efficiency (~98%) ‐ Due to soft‐switching technology, the high efficiency of Resonant Link results in significantly less power losses over the life of the equipment.
Use of high frequency nanocrystalline transformers ‐ Voltages, AC and DC, can be transformed by utilizing integral nanocrystalline transformers, operating at 6‐20kHz,  which are a fraction of the weight (e.g. 250kVA unit at 20kHz is 11kg with windings) and physical size of conventional transformers and are an integral part of the converters.
No AC or DC short circuit protection required ‐ Resonant Link converters are completely fault‐immune operation and provide natural fault current limiting (i.e. zero‐current turn‐off at <1ms). No costly and bulky AC and DC protection for short circuits required. 
Multi‐port operation ‐ Multi‐port operation yields instantaneous redirection of power flow.
Scalable to 50MW according to the US Navy’s ONR.

Delta Elektronika is an independent manufacturer of DC power supplies. It is a family owned company with a strong technical culture. Delta Elektronika was established in 1959 and has had since its headquarters based in the South West of the Netherlands on the island Schouwen-Duiveland. Delta Elektronika designs and manufactures world class DC power units in a product line ranging from 150W to 15kW.

DC Power Supplies
A power supply is often taken for granted as it is seen as an insignificant part of equipment. For most it is just an electronic box ordered at the last moment. However, a power supply can be compared to our heart; It’s often neglected and we tend to pay more attention to our hair. Yet if the heart fails, the system goes down.

Design concept
Delta power supplies have a reputation of being remarkably reliable. Therefore our design concept puts a strong emphasis on long lifetime and excellent technical specifications. The specifications of our products may seem unrealistic at first, but when measured they turn out to be even better as defined. Delta users expect perfection, an almost infinite life time at continuous full power and low cost of ownership. Ongoing research makes it possible to produce products that can meet these ever increasing demands.

Result
As a result of our design philosophy the units react more than 10 times faster on load transients, produce hardly audible noise and produce 10 – 30 times less electromagnetic interference. Delta customers will never face any problems due to radiated or conducted emissions of our power supplies. The same design philosophy applies for immunity: the toughest standard is not good enough for us. A Delta power supply will always operate reliable, even in a very noisy environment.All our power supply units are thoroughly tested before being dispatched to the customer.This ensures long term correct functioning of each unit and client satisfaction. Delta Elektronika produces world class DC power supplies.
